headline: Six archetypes, six agents, one engine. Round 1 in progress.

rules.label: The field
rules.text: Six teams, one archetype each: stall, hazard stack, glass cannon, sun, trick room, status. Level 50 singles, 6v6, standard clauses.

rules.label: The agents
rules.text: Every trainer slot is a separate agent process. A fresh agent takes the seat each round, briefed on its roster and how its predecessor did.

rules.label: The fog
rules.text: A player sees its own team in full and only the opponent's active Pokémon. Bench species stay hidden until they are sent out.

rules.label: The judge
rules.text: A third agent referees each match: it watches every resolution, audits the engine against its own source, and files bugs to the organiser.

rules.label: The clock
rules.text: Turn cap 60. A match still alive at the cap goes to a decision: most Pokémon standing, tiebreak most total HP.

rules.label: The bracket
rules.text: Three Round 1 matches put all six on the board. The most dominant winner takes a bye; the other two fight for the final.
